articles.title: Moicano, platinado e tranças: veja os penteados de Neymar na carreira | G1
articles.standfirst: Desde 2009, Neymar se destaca, além do desempenho esportivo, pelas mudanças de visual, que viram tendência entre os fãs.
articles.summary: Desde 2009, Neymar se destaca, além do desempenho esportivo, pelas mudanças de visual e estilos adotados, que viram tendência entre os fãs.
articles.body:
Neymar Jr. chamou a atenção do público nas redes sociais após aparecer com o visual novo. O jogador abriu mão da barba cheia e em degradê, e passou a aderir o formato de bigode e cavanhaque.

Desde jovem, o craque se acostumou a transitar entre diferentes cortes de cabelo e popularizar estilos que não eram frequentemente utilizados, como o moicano e o corte em '"V" , além dos cabelos coloridos e platinados.

Os diferentes cortes de cabelo de Neymar — Foto: Reprodução

Neymar em campo pelo Santos FC em 2009. — Foto: Neymar Jr. Site

Aos 17 anos, Neymar entrava em campo pela primeira vez com a camisa do Santos FC, em março de 2009. Naquela ocasião, ainda utilizava o cabelo raspado, também conhecido como corte militar, antecedendo o início dos cortes marcantes do craque.

Neymar com a emblemática camisa azul e o moicano mais cheio, em 2012 — Foto: Ricardo Saibun / Santos FC

Em 2010, na sua primeira temporada completa, o corte mais simples já não era mais utilizado, dando lugar aos penteados mais elaborados e o início de uma das maiores febres de estilo da época: o moicano.

O primeiro moicano utilizado por Neymar tratava-se de um corte com o cabelo mais curto. Com o passar do tempo, o estilo foi ganhando novas formas e adições. Ainda em 2010, Neymar aderiu o mesmo corte, com a adição de uma trança na parte traseira do cabelo, o que repercutiu bastante à época.

Cabelos de Neymar na primeira passagem pelo Santos

Nos anos seguintes, o atacante continou alternando entre os diferentes formatos do corte. Em 2011, venceu a Copa Libertadores com o moicano junto de luzes nas pontas do cabelo. Em 2012, apostou em um penteado mais cheio, que se tornaria um dos mais emblemáticos da sua carreira, junto da camisa azul do Santos FC no período.

Na virada de 2012 para 2013, Neymar trocou o moicano por um pentado mais discreto, porém, platinado por completo. Antes de sua ida ao Barcelona, o camisa 11 manteve o mesmo corte, mas abriu mão dos cabelos loiros.

Neymar adota moicano com tranças na parte traseira, em 2011 — Foto: Reprodução

Durante a passagem pelo Barcelona, alguns visuais ficaram marcados para os torcedores e fãs do jogador. O camisa 11 manteve o penteado com o qual saiu do Santos por toda a sua primeira temporada no time. Na temporada 2014/15, quando venceu a UEFA Champions League, ele retornou ao estilo moicano, agora junto do degradê, presente pela primeira vez na carreira do atacante.

Neymar durante passagem pelo Barcelona — Foto: Divulgação/Instituto Projeto Neymar Jr.

Por conta da conquista europeia, Neymar cumpriu uma promessa que havia feito e retomou o estilo platinado. Em 2016, variou entre cortes com o cabelo raspado, curtos e topetes.

O brasileiro deixou o Barcelona, rumo ao futebol francês, em 2017. Naquele momento, utilizava o cabelo com um corte degradê , conhecido como ''low fade'', junto de mechas douradas nas pontas onduladas.

Cabelos de Neymar na passagem pelo FC Barcelona

Nos quase oito anos em que atuou pelo futebol francês, Neymar aderiu diferentes estilos de penteados, inclusive em momentos com a Seleção Brasileira, em 2018 e 2022. Além disso, foi um dos responsáveis pela popularização do "corte em V", que viria a ser tendência entre os jovens.

Na Copa do Mundo da Rússia, em 2018, o camisa 10 do Brasil estreou diante da Suiça com um estilo renovado, utilizando um topete mais alto e totalmente loiro. O corte gerou grande repercussão na época e a situação fez com que o atacante alterasse o visual para o restante da competição.

Em 2019, o camisa 10 do PSG promoveu o retorno do moicano, desta vez, com a adição da barba cheia pela primeira vez na carreira. No ano seguinte, Neymar iniciou a temporada com o cabelo raspado, mas manteve a configuração da barba mais volumosa.

Com a criação do 'Ney Day', campanha que tomou as redes sociais no período da pandemia, para acompanhar a campanha do PSG na UEFA Champions League daquela temporada, Neymar atendeu aos fãs e fez novamente o corte moicano para os jogos decisivos da competição.

Neymar chega ao Al-Hilal em 2023 — Foto: Reuters / Getty Images

De 2020 até 2023, ano em que saiu da França, o camisa 10 passou por cabelos coloridos, platinados, moicanos e degradês.

A estrela brasileira chegou ao Al-Hilal e, durante o tempo em que esteve por lá, utilizou penteados mais discretos, mantendo o seu tradicional moicano.

Neymar Jr. fez vários estilos de tranças com a trancista Danielle Castela — Foto: Redes sociais

Quando voltou ao Santos, em fevereiro de 2025, o craque passou a utilizar tranças, as quais fez junto de sua esposa, Bruna Biancardi, sua filha Mavie e seu filho mais velho, Davi Lucca.

O jogador alterou o estilo da trança três vezes, alternando entre um estilo mais simples, com detalhes dourados, brancos e coloridos. Na última vez em que aderiu ao penteado, escolheu o tema azul, em alusão ao uniforme utilizado pelo Peixe na temporada 2012 e relançado em 2025.

No período que antecedeu a Copa do Mundo de 2026, Neymar voltou a mudar o visual, com o cabelo loiro. Agora, em uma cor mais escura, mais cheio na parte de cima e com o degradê em formato de 'V' na parte traseira.

articles.title: Tottenham continue downward spiral as Arsenal prove they are not perfect - Premier League hits and misses
articles.summary: Sky Sports' writers assess the Premier League action from Friday and Saturday as Chelsea, Arsenal and Tottenham all suffer embarrassing defeats...
articles.body:
This Tottenham team are not a lost cause. But being bad in both boxes is a footballing nightmare. And that is where Spurs find themselves right now. Five games, no wins. And back in the relegation zone.

Latest news and rumours: Tottenham | Aston Villa

They are wasteful in front of goal and then seemingly determined to self-destruct at the other end. Sloppy passes, poor decisions, defensive lapses - gifts being handed out to the opposition.

And Roberto De Zerbi cut a frustrated figure. He called the defending for Aston Villa's second goal "unacceptable".

You could feel the anger bubbling underneath him in his post-match press conference. The most damning admission? He didn't even speak to his players after the defeat. That tells you plenty.

What was there to say? The same mistakes keep appearing. The same problems keep costing Spurs. And now, just when the manager needs his players on the training pitch to put it right, the international break arrives. Some of them won't see De Zerbi again for more than two weeks.

This isn't a lost season. There is too much talent in this Tottenham squad for that. But talent means very little if you keep shooting yourself in the foot. Top teams don't behave like this.

And if De Zerbi doesn't get that habit out of them quickly, this project is going to become another season of humiliation. Lewis Jones

Nicolas Jackson absolutely tormented Tottenham with a brilliant mixture of silky touches and bruising physicality. He gave Spurs' centre-backs no peace, constantly offering an out-ball, protecting possession and bringing those around him into the game.

It was the kind of performance that reminded you why Chelsea saw so much in him. Jackson doesn't always get the goals his all-round game perhaps deserves, but that can sometimes disguise just how valuable he is to the team. When he is playing with this confidence, everything seems to click. The midfielders have someone to find. The wide players have someone to combine with. Runners have space to attack.

It was a proper centre-forward's performance that included the game's key goal, which doubled Villa's lead.

It was a demonstration to Tottenham of exactly what they are missing through the middle. Lewis Jones

Arsenal lost 3-0 but it should have been six. Brighton missed three big chances to add to their hefty tally. We've rarely seen this from Mikel Arteta's team.

The last time Arsenal conceded three goals in a Premier League away game was in December 2023, and the Gunners even won that game at Luton 4-3. The last time they lost by a three-goal margin was May 2023, coincidentally against Brighton.

Latest news and rumours: Brighton | Arsenal

Arsenal went the entire of 2024, 2025 and most of 2026 without doing what they did at Brighton. It was uncharacteristic display, particularly on the road - where Arsenal have accumulated more away points than any other team in the last five years.

Arteta knew that Arsenal were in trouble right from the first throw-in in the game. And the way in which Arsenal were second-best from that moment to the 95th minute, this was clearly a bad day at the office, but not part of a wider problem.

Arteta was keen to call for perspective after the game: Arsenal have won every other match this season after staggering so many late arrivals from the World Cup and suffering a fair few injuries in defence.

The last time Arsenal lost in this manner was the 2026 Carabao Cup final - after which, the tactical template of 'how to beat Arsenal' then spilled into a FA Cup exit, a loss to Bournemouth and then that defeat at Manchester City which temporarily turned the title race tide.

The lengthy international break will help, but Arsenal need to make sure this Brighton blip doesn't become wobble. Sam Blitz

Brighton have started the season in electric fashion. They are comfortably the Premier League's top scorers, who have added goals to the third-best defence in the league from last season.

Interestingly, all under Fabian Hurzeler, they have won a game against the reigning champions three seasons in a row. But when they beat Man City and Liverpool in previous years, those two clubs were already in freefall. Stopping Arsenal in their full flow makes this Brighton win the best out of the three.

What makes Brighton unique is how they respond to challenges? Lose Carlos Baleba? Chema Andres will arrive and step up. Danny Welbeck leaves and Georginio Rutter is out? Babis Kostoulas will scrore to get you wins over United and Arsenal.

Jack Hinshelwood is injured? Pascal Gross will get you seven goal contributions in five games. "He's like a fine wine," said Hurzeler about the German after the game. The same goes for his team. They just keep getting better and better. Sam Blitz

There is something quite endearing about Everton under David Moyes. After all the hardships of the transfer window, with the smallest squad in the division, they continue to overachieve. VAR even tried to undermine their victory over Ipswich, but they rallied to make sure it didn't matter.

Everton remain unbeaten in their opening seven games across all competitions, complete with five clean sheets. When asked if working with a small squad has actually been to his advantage, Moyes said: "We're trying to make it that way."

Their 21 shots against Ipswich were their most in a Premier League game at the Hill Dickinson Stadium, but Moyes still sees plenty to improve on. "I am ratting the players like you wouldn't believe," he added. "Why are we not scoring more?"

Thierno Barry was denied what most would consider a legitimate goal by VAR, but Everton were also responsible for squandering four big chances themselves. That level of profligacy will come back to bite in certain games. And yet, you cannot help but be impressed by the way Moyes has maximised the finite tools at his disposal.

His managerial nouse can take Everton further than their recruitment limitations suggested was possible. Laura Hunter

It was Newcastle's valiant defending that may have seen them over the line in their narrow 2-1 victory against Hull, but it was their blistering first-half attack which proved the telling difference on the way to three points - especially that of Harvey Barnes.

Barnes provided two assists in just seven minutes, the earliest into a Premier League game a Newcastle player has set up mulitple goals, taking the record from Fabian Schar who managed the feat in nine minutes in that 6-1 demolition job of Tottenham in 2023.

The difference here was that Barnes was facing a resolute defence that had only conceded in one of their previous four Premier League games - not that that stopped the winger picking their locks twice in four minutes.

Latest news and rumours: Newcastle | Hull

His deft inside through ball for Willock to lash home came just four minutes before slipping in a galloping Hall on the outside of the opponents' box - but he continued to provide Newcastle a creative spark throughout the 90 minutes, whipping in teasing crosses even when his side was up against it.

Barnes now has five goal contributions in seven games across all competitions for new boss Matthias Jaissle, but was still overlooked for Thomas Tuchel's England squad, missing out to the likes of Eberechi Eze, who has not started a Premier League game for Arsenal so far this campaign. If the Englishman keeps producing game-defining performances like he has so far under Jaissle, it surely will not be long before he earns the trust of the other German head coach he is eager to impress. Noah Langford

For the first time this season, Chelsea were without their infamous front three of 'JP Morgan' due to Joao Pedro's injury.

Danny Welbeck started in the Brazilian's place and it was set up for the England international to do well. Brentford were Welbeck's favourite opponents in his career, with six goals in his nine previous matches against the Bees before Friday night.

But Chelsea weren't the same in attack. The new-formed attack of Welbeck, Cole Palmer and Morgan Rogers managed just one shot on target between them at the Gtech. They averaged three shots on target in each of their previous four league games.

Pedro is not just a goalscorer, he's a player who drops off the frontline to link up with others. He has just as managed goals as he has assist this season. Welbeck is less of a creator, more of a clinical scorer.

Xabi Alonso says Pedro's absence cannot be used as an excuse - but the Chelsea manager is surely hoping in private that he is back quickly after the international break. Sam Blitz

Brentford's best buy of the transfer window may not be Mamadou Sangare after all. Jannik Schuster has announced himself to the Premier League after his £13m move from Red Bull Salzburg.

For all of Brentford's excellent attacking play - they scored three times, Igor Thiago got off the mark for the season and Kevin Schade's two assists rubberstamped his brilliant start to the season - it was in defence where they shone just as much. They are the first team to stop Chelsea scoring this season.

Schuster was a big part of that, with some outstanding defensive numbers earning the 20-year-old Player of the Match.

His 12 clearances was twice as many as the next Brentford player, which is not bad given his first home Premier League start was up against a formidable and experienced opponents in Danny Welbeck.

"I loved him from the second I saw him," said Keith Andrews after the win over Chelsea. "His fearless, you could see his character from just watching clips. He's whole-hearted, he has personality and aggression. They way he truly plays, he loves defending."

articles.title: Morante entra por Iker Losada en la lista del Betis para La Coruña
articles.standfirst: El canterano vuelve con el primer equipo y no jugará este fin de semana con el filial
articles.summary: El canterano vuelve con el primer equipo y no jugará este fin de semana con el filial
articles.body: El Betis ha dado a conocer la lista de 24 convocados por Manuel Pellegrini para el partido de mañana frente al Deportivo en Riazor. El regreso del canterano José Antonio Morante a una convocatoria del primer equipo en detrimento de Iker Losada, quien se queda en la capital hispalense por decisión técnica, es la única novedad de la misma. El técnico chileno sigue sin poder contar con Aitor Ruibal y Diego Llorente. Ambos jugadores siguen con sus respectivos procesos de recuperación para que puedan ir incorporándose de forma paulatina a los entrenamientos en las próximas semanas y para que puedan estar a disposición de Pellegrini lo antes posible. El primer enfrentamiento tras el parón para el Betis será frente a Osasuna el próximo domingo 11 de octubre en la Cartuja. La convocatoria completa del Betis para el duelo ante el Deportivo de La Coruña -falta hacer un descarte- la forman Valles, Diego Conde, Manu González, Bellerín, Ortiz, Bartra, Natan, Valentín Gómez, Fran García, Junior Firpo, Facundo Bernal, Marc Roca, Deossa, Dani Ceballos, Fornals, Isco, Lo Celso, Fidalgo, Antony, Morante, Abde, Riquelme, Cucho Hernández y Parrott.

articles.title: Who was Sandro Mazzola? All about Inter Milan and Italy’s legendary midfielder who passed away at 83
articles.summary: International Sports News: Sandro Mazzola, one of the greatest midfielders in Italian football history, has died at the age of 83. His cause of death has not been announced publ.
articles.body: Sandro Mazzola, one of the greatest midfielders in Italian football history, has died at the age of 83. His cause of death has not been announced publicly. Inter Milan confirmed the death of the club legend on Saturday. Mazzola spent his entire professional career with Inter and became one of the defining figures of the famous ‘Grande Inter’ team of the 1960s.He won major domestic and European honours with the Nerazzurri and also enjoyed a celebrated international career with Italy.Who was Sandro Mazzola? Football star leaves behind an unforgettable Inter Milan legacySandro Mazzola joined Inter Miami as a young player and remained with the club for all 17 seasons of his professional career. He became a key part of Helenio Herrera’s great Inter side that dominated European football during the 1960s.His greatest club moment came in the 1964 European Cup final against Real Madrid. Mazzola scored twice as Inter secured a 3-1 victory. The performance earned him praise from Hungarian football legend Ferenc Puskas, who had also played against Mazzola’s father, Valentino.Valentino Mazzola was one of the biggest stars of Torino’s famous ‘Grande Torino’ team. He died in the 1949 Superga air disaster, which killed 31 people. The tragedy happened before Sandro had reached his seventh birthday.Mazzola continued to build his own legacy at Inter. He won four Scudetti and helped the club win back-to-back European Cups in 1964 and 1965. He was also the Serie A top scorer in 1965.His performances made him one of the leading players of his generation. In 1971, he finished second in the Ballon d’Or voting behind Johan Cruyff.Mazzola was equally important for Italy. He represented the national team for 70 matches and scored 22 goals. His biggest international honour came at the 1968 European Championship. Italy defeated Yugoslavia 2-0 in the replayed final in Rome to win the trophy.Two years later, Mazzola helped Italy reach the 1970 World Cup final in Mexico. Italy eventually lost 4-1 to Brazil, led by the legendary Pele.Inter paid tribute to its former captain and symbol after his death.The club said, “There are those who enter history. And then there are those who become the very history of Inter itself. From a young Nerazzurri boy to an eternal symbol, Sandro Mazzola has spanned generations, winning, thrilling, and passing down the love for these colours. He shone on the field, and he shines even now, the star with the moustache.”The statement added, “Who, as he has often recounted, had just one, final wish: ‘To be remembered as a good man, who always gives his all, even when it seems impossible.’”Inter president Giuseppe Marotta also paid tribute, saying, “Today, another piece of the Nerazzurri legend leaves us. Sandro was Inter: he joined the club as a boy and chose to stay here forever, one shirt, seventeen seasons, an entire lifetime. With (Helenio) Herrera’s Grande Inter, he wrote chapters that nobody will ever erase. Today, it is our duty to preserve his memory, because a club is only as great as its memory. And Sandro’s memory will remain with us, forever.”Mazzola retired from professional football in 1977 after a 17-year career. He later remained involved in the game. He held an executive role at Inter before becoming sporting director at Torino.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. Download the TOI app.

articles.title: El Barça desvela las fechas de las fases finales del Spotify Camp Nou
articles.standfirst: El vicepresidente asegura que no hay plazo para el inicio del Nou Palau
articles.summary: El vicepresidente asegura que no hay plazo para el inicio del Nou Palau
articles.body: Las obras de remodelación del Spotify Camp Nou van con retraso y se han salido del presupuesto inicial, pero el Barcelona tiene definidas y claras las próximas fases. La entidad culé calcula que en poco más de un año ya estará concluida una de las partes más ambiciosas, la colocación de la cúpula, y que en enero de 2028 el aforo ya será de 95.000 localidades. Para la campaña 28-29, el remodelado campo, que acogerá la final de la Champions League, ya estará totalmente concluido y con una capacidad de 105.000 asientos. El Barcelona abrirá una pequeña parte de la tercera grada y algunos palcos vips a finales este año, pero no será hasta marzo cuando estas zonas tendrán un gran impulso y la capacidad del Spotify Camp Nou pasará de la 62.000 localidades actuales hasta las 72.000. "En marzo, ya debería estar en funcionamiento el 75 por ciento del hospitality vip", señaló Ferran Olivé, vicepresidente económico. Otro de los grandes hitos será la colocación de la cúpula, que obligará a los de Flick a una nueva mudanza a Montjuïc durante algunos meses a inicios de la próxima temporada. "La previsión es que esté colocada a finales de octubre e inicios de noviembre, pero la previsión de ingresos será para finales de enero a nivel presupuestario. Queremos ser prudentes", comentó Ferran Olivé. Será entonces, enero de 2028, cuando la capacidad del remodelado Spotify Camp Nou ascienda hasta los 95.000 asientos. Su máximo aforo, no obstante, no se completará hasta la campaña 28-29. Será de 105.000. El Palau, en cambio, no tiene fecha de inicio de obra. "No da ingresos ni beneficios. El Estadi, sí, por eso concentraremos los esfuerzos en el Estadi. El Palau da otro nivel al club, pero ya nos lo plantearemos más adelante. Estamos buscando inversores externos para llevar el proyecto a cabo y para su explotación para 30 o 50 años", sentenció Olivé.

articles.title: El West Ham evita un K.O. en el derbi más 'caliente' de Londres
articles.standfirst: Los 'hammers' igualaron un 2-0 al descanso contra el Milwall (2-2)
articles.summary: Los 'hammers' igualaron un 2-0 al descanso contra el Milwall (2-2)
articles.body: Existen infinidad de derbis repartidos por la ciudad de Londres. Pero muy pocos con la rivalidad que protagonizan los Millwall-West Ham. No se veían las caras desde 2012 y los 'hammers' evitaron un K.O. igualando (2-2) en la recta final del encuentro. No tardó en golpear un Millwall que se puso por delante nada más superarse el primer cuarto de hora por medio de una acción que define al fútbol inglés de toda la vida. Tras un saque de banda directo al punto de penalti y una doble intervención por parte de Hermansen, Caleb Taylor desató la locura en The Den. Fue doble el premio para el Millwall antes de poner dirección al túnel de vestuarios gracias al tanto de Neghli, otra vez, tras un saque de banda a cargo de Lyndon Dykes. Le sobraban motivos a Nuno Espíritu Santo para justificar la doble modificación que realizó para afrontar la segunda parte. La dinámica del encuentro cambió completamente. El West Ham, que tan sólo realizó un disparo a lo largo de todo el primer tiempo, comenzó a volcarse sobre la portería rival y, a falta de un cuarto de hora para el final, los goles de Mohamadou Kanté -acabó expulsado por una falta sobre Lisbie cuando se marchaba solo- y Mavropanos igualaron el marcador.

articles.title: Sergio Camello se va al parón con récord
articles.standfirst: El atacante franjirrojo volvió a anotar gol, esta vez ante Osasuna, y superó su mejor marca en Primera división
articles.summary: El atacante franjirrojo volvió a anotar gol, esta vez ante Osasuna, y superó su mejor marca en Primera división
articles.body: Sergio Camello lo ha vuelto a hacer. Su ausencia en la lista de Luis de la Fuente del viernes no supuso un problema en el juego del rayista que volvió a ser protagonista. Anotó su séptimo gol de la temporada ante Osasuna y superó su mejor marca goleadora en LaLiga en tan solo siete encuentros. Ante el Espanyol se frenó la racha goleadora de Camello. Se tuvo que contentar con la victoria y con un larguero. Sin embargo, el madrileño demostró por qué estaba en la mente del seleccionador nacional y marcó el gol del empate en El Sadar. El tanto llegó después de un gran pase en profundidad de Unai López hacia Adriá Pedrosa. El lateral zurdo giró el cuerpo para encontrar a su 'nueve' que definió con la zurda. Con este tanto, Sergio Camello iguala a Guilherme, con 24 goles, como el cuarto máximo goleador del conjunto rayista en Primera división y se pone a uno de Jon Pérez Bolo. Aunque su nombre no estuviera en la lista de Luis de la Fuente, el delantero sigue haciendo méritos y sumando goles. El Rayo Vallecano aún no tiene asegurada la continuidad de su jugador más diferencial para la próxima campaña. Sergio Camello acaba contrato en junio de 2027 y si sigue así, 'novias' no le van a faltar.

articles.title: From Erling Haaland and Kai Rooney to Mikel Arteta’s son Gabriel, meet the football wonderkids following the footsteps of their famous parents
articles.summary: International Sports News: Becoming a professional footballer requires talent, dedication and years of hard work. But for some young players, football is already part of their f.
articles.body: Becoming a professional footballer requires talent, dedication and years of hard work. But for some young players, football is already part of their family history. Several youngsters are now trying to follow in the footsteps of famous parents who made their mark in sport.Erling Haaland is one of the biggest examples after following his father Alf-Inge Haaland into professional football. The Premier League and its academies also feature several other youngsters with famous sporting or celebrity parents. From Kai Rooney to Gabriel Arteta, these rising talents are now looking to build careers of their own.From Kai Rooney to Phoenix Offiah, exploring how the next generation is making its markOne of the most recognisable names on the list is Kai Rooney, the eldest son of Manchester United legend Wayne Rooney and Coleen Rooney. The 16-year-old is following his father’s path at Manchester United and recently signed scholarship terms with the club.Kai has already featured for United’s Under-18 side. He scored two goals and provided an assist in seven appearances last season. The teenager has also revealed that he models his game on former Arsenal winger Gabriel Martinelli.Kai faces obvious comparisons with his father. His middle name is also Wayne, making the connection even stronger.Another youngster attracting attention is Kingston Haye, the 12-year-old son of former boxing world champion David Haye. articles.body:

The result leaves Arsenal in fourth after a second consecutive draw, while United are off the foot of the table with their first point of the campaign.

Chelsea rose to second, two points behind leaders Manchester City, with a 2-0 win over Birmingham thanks to goals from Lexi Potter and Melvine Malard.

Isobel Goodwin's brace had London City two goals ahead after 15 minutes and, despite Jodie Hutton halving the deficit in the 39th minute with a fine finish, Jana Fernandez restored their advantage before half-time.

articles.title: Dundee 2-1 Motherwell: Dark Blues survive late scare to move up to fourth in Scottish Premiership
articles.summary: Report as Dundee claim their first win in four and climb to fourth after goals from Joe Westley and Bradley Fink secure a nervy 2-1 victory over Motherwell, who suffer a third successive league defeat.
articles.body:
Joe Westley and Bradley Fink gave Dundee a two-goal cushion but the Steelmen hit back just before the break through Alex Lowry.

Both sides had chances in the second half but, despite a nervy finish, the Dark Blues held on to take all three points to move up to fourth in the table with their first win in four while Motherwell have now lost three league games in a row.

The hosts made two changes to the team that lost to Hearts a fortnight ago with Jack Moorhouse and Callum Jones coming in for Ryan Finnigan and Fin Robertson, who both suffered injuries at Tynecastle.

Westley was also in the home starting line-up despite fracturing a cheekbone against the Jam Tarts with the striker wearing a protective mask.

The visitors drafted in Ibrahim Said and Seb Palmer-Houlden for Regan Charles-Cook and Jardell Kanga following the heavy defeat to Aberdeen in midweek.

The Steelmen had a chance in just the third minute when Lukas Fadinger hit a shot from the edge of the Dundee box with goalkeeper Owen Goodman diving to his right to palm to safety.

However, the home fans finally had something to shout about in the 23rd minute. Referee Ross Hardie was called over to the pitchside monitor by the VAR for a possible hand ball in the visitors' box by Emmanuel Longelo.

Hardie decided to point to the spot with Westley stepping up to take the penalty. Motherwell keeper Alex Paulsen dived the right way and got two hands on the ball but was unable to keep it out of the back of the net.

The hosts came close to doubling their advantage when Fink was sent racing through on goal down the left but his low, angled shot cannoned off the far post.

However, the Dark Blues extended their lead in the 40th minute. Ryan Astley smashed a cross in from the right towards Fink, who glanced a header towards goal. The keeper seemed to leave it but the ball cannoned off the inside of the post and into the back of the net.

Motherwell responded four minutes later when Tom Sparrow found Lowry inside the Dundee box and he took a touch before clinically finishing past Goodman.

Dundee sparked into life in the 60th minute when Drey Wright played a great ball into Alan Forrest with the winger then finding Westley, who hit a fierce shot that Paulsen tipped over the bar.

The keeper then made an even better stop when he pulled off a great reaction save to keep out a powerful Astley back-post header.

In the 88th minute, Goodman had to come to Dundee's rescue twice in quick succession to tip over an attempted clearance from Idris Odutayo before making another vital stop from a Martin Moormann header.

articles.title: Ex-Mexico manager Javier Aguirre nearing La Liga return with Valencia, per reports
articles.summary: After leading Mexico during the 2026 World Cup, veteran manager Javier Aguirre is set for a return to Spain.
articles.body:
Y si sí? The leader of Mexico at the 2026 World Cup may be trying to convince a new set of fans to believe.

Veteran coach Javier Aguirre left El Tri after the summer tournament, carrying out a succession plan that saw Mexico legend Rafa Marquez take the helm ahead of 2030. The 67-year-old said he hoped to travel with his wife and enjoy time with his grandkids, but he could already be set for his next role.

Multiple reports, including one from Valencia -based newspaper Superdeporte , indicate that Aguirre will take over relegation-threatened Valencia CF.

The historic club recently fired both manager Carlos Corberán and CEO Ron Gourlay after a winless start to the first five matches of the La Liga season. Valencia is in the final season of play at the Mestalla stadium and hoped to start the campaign strong after closing out last year as one of the hottest teams in Spain .

Instead, it was a return to form from the start of the 2025-26 season, and Valencia opted to seek new leadership.

There is an agreement in principle for that new leader to be Aguirre, reports indicate, with only a few terms to be worked out. One of those is Valencia being able to free up fitness coach Pol Lorente, a long-time Aguirre staff member who stayed on the FMF staff with Marquez .

Ernesto Valverde also was a strong candidate, but reportedly opted to stay out of management this season after coaching Athletic last year.

"I think it'd be a bit imprudent for me to speak about Aguirre. His record speaks to who he is, which is why like I said it'd be a bit bold for me to speak about him," Valencia interim manager Oscar Sanchez said in a news conference Saturday, Sept. 19.

Aguirre's record in Spain is a positive one, earning a reputation as a coach who can help teams stay in the top division. He helped Mallorca stay up in 2022 and almost was able to rescue Leganés in 2019-20, coming a point short after arriving in November.

Now, in theory, Aguirre will come into the job with much more time to work his magic and put the team back in the top half of the league where history suggests it belongs.

The move also could lead to a reunion of sorts with a pair of England stars who helped knock Mexico out at the Estadio Azteca in the round of 16. Aguirre's playful banter with Anthony Gordon , now with FC Barcelona , went viral. Aguirre also shared words with Real Madrid 's Jude Bellingham before and after that clash.

The reports indicate Aguirre could be on the east coast of Spain working as soon as the start of next week. Valencia sits 19th in the 20-team La Liga ahead of a Sunday, Sept. 20 meeting with Real Sociedad .

articles.title: Bonucci reveals how tempted he was about leaving Juventus to play for Pep Guardiola
articles.summary: Manchester City were keen to sign Leonardo Bonucci during the peak of his performances at Juventus, with the defender tempted by the possibility of moving to...
articles.body:
Manchester City were keen to sign Leonardo Bonucci during the peak of his performances at Juventus , with the defender tempted by the possibility of moving to the Premier League and working under Pep Guardiola. Despite the attraction of such an opportunity, Bonucci ultimately decided to remain with the Bianconeri.

At the time, Juventus were dominating Italian football and had reached the Champions League final twice in three seasons. Bonucci was one of the most important members of a defensive unit that made the Bianconeri one of the hardest teams for opponents to break down.

Guardiola admired Bonucci's style of play and wanted City to add the defender to their squad. The Citizens therefore made significant efforts to get a deal done, with one of the most important steps being to convince Bonucci that a move to England was the right decision.

Manchester City wanted to turn the defender's head and encourage him to ask Juventus to allow him to leave. However, the Bianconeri worked to prevent that from happening, while Bonucci ultimately remained committed to the club.

Bonucci has now revisited the period when Guardiola attempted to convince him to move to the Premier League. The Juventus defender acknowledged how difficult it was to ignore the opportunity when such a respected manager made contact with him.

The interest created a genuine dilemma for Bonucci, particularly because of his admiration for Guardiola's football. However, his connection with Juventus remained equally powerful and played a major role in his eventual decision.

Bonucci explained that Guardiola's preference for building from the back made the Manchester City manager particularly appealing. Speaking via Gianluca di Marzio , he recalled how the courtship developed.

"For my style of play, the coach who prefers playing from the back is Guardiola . So began a heated courtship that lasted for several weeks . When Guardiola calls you, it's not just any courtship. You start to falter, there was the European Championship in between and I had to stay focused, but even during the tournament there were moments of sharing."

He added: "For my part, the idea of ​​leaving Juventus made my heart tremble . Some days I would say to myself 'Wonderful, the Premier League, Guardiola,' the next day instead 'I've always dreamed of Juventus,' and I have to say that Alessandro Lucci helped me a lot in this."

Bonucci ultimately chose to follow his attachment to Juventus rather than pursue the opportunity in England. His comments show how difficult the decision was, despite the appeal of working with Guardiola and experiencing Premier League football.

articles.title: OFFICIALLY OFFICIAL: Kamil Grabara suffers ACL tear in training
articles.summary: Fate has smacked Juve’s new No. 2 keeper in the face—or kneecap.
articles.body:
We really just can't have nice things anymore, can we?

Juventus confirmed on their web site that goalkeeper Kamil Grabara suffered a torn ACL during Saturday's training session. This comes barely two days after Grabara made his debut for the club against NEC Nijmegen in the Europa League on Thursday.

It was a successful debut, at that. The Polish keeper made every save he had to make and even notched an out-of-the-blue assist when his opposite number, Nikolas Polster , completely whiffed at a long ball he had aimed at Nico González, allowing the Argentine to score with minimal effort.

It's an inopportune time to lose Grabara, as the two-game-a-week slate will demand a lot of the club once the game returns from the international break. It's also worth noting that Guglielmo Vicario , who Grabara was backing up, is by no means a sure thing in goal after going through a horrific season last year at Tottenham Hotspur and, frankly, could go into the tank at a moment's notice.

The way forward for Grabara isn't 100 percent certain. The club's statement gave no indication of the severity of the tear, only that his course of treatment and timetable would be ascertained after consulting with specialists. Given the nature of ACLs, it's almost certain we won't see him for at least six months, perhaps longer.

How Luciano Spalletti deals with things will also now be interesting to gauge. The injury bumps cheerleader-in-chief Carlo Pinsoglio into the No. 2 spot behind Vicario for now, but how things go behind him is going to be a question. The starter at the NextGen, Riccardo Radu, could see some callups, and there are a couple of free agent keepers floating around who could be brought up in a pinch, but those pickings are slim.

The list is probably topped by Alessio Cragno , who was once one of the country's up-and-coming keepers at Cagliari but, at 32, is recovering from an Achilles injury and has spent the last two seasons attached to Serie B sides. Salvatore Sirigu is 39 and has been without a club for the last year, and his long tenure with Torino may see him less willing to come to the other side of Turin. Daniele Padelli , 40, was Udinese 's third keeper last year and hasn't seen the field since the 2024-25 season.

Given the bare bones of that group, it's possible Juve simply stands pat with Pinsoglio and whoever gets the call from the NextGen until January, where they could make a move depending on just how long Grabara will be out. Frankly, I'd absolutely adore seeing some real, honest-to-goodness Pinso Time in a Coppa match or something. That said, this is a big blow for Grabara personally and for Juve's depth at one of the few positions they didn't already have depth problems at. Here's hoping for his quick recovery.

articles.title: Everyone's finally caught up to Liverpool's biggest problem: Except Liverpool
articles.summary: Liverpool have a massive problem on their hands and people are finally noticing. Except Liverpool, however.Liverpool spent an awful lot of money in the summe...
articles.body:
Liverpool have a massive problem on their hands and people are finally noticing. Except Liverpool, however.

Liverpool spent an awful lot of money in the summer once again. Only this time, they didn't sell over £200m worth of players to fund it all - it was a massive outlay, bringing in Bradley Barcola , Victor Munoz, Ronald Araujo on loan and locking down some youth players for 2027, too.

And yet, the team doesn't appear to work very well. Liverpool haven't been awful this season but they haven't been particularly good, either. Andoni Iraola is still figuring out the right mix of players - but there are legitimate questions over whether there is a right mix of players in this group.

Richard Hughes has built a squad that isn't a natural fit, ignoring a gigantic problem that everyone has finally caught up to. Except for Liverpool, of course.

There has been an enormous amount of talk about Liverpool's midfield this season. It's principally because it looks so unbalanced, with the Reds leaving gaps through the middle and looking unable to control games.

That's led for calls to sign a defensive midfielder, while now you've got the likes of The Times' Jonathan Northcroft pointing out that Liverpool have overwhelmingly attacking midfielders in their group and that creates a natural imbalance.

And that's all true! Liverpool need a defensive midfielder. All of their top midfield options - Ryan Gravenberch , Dominik Szoboszlai and Alexis Mac Allister - are natural attack-minded midfielders, too.

Only, this was a problem last season . It was arguably the problem last season and something we went on and on about . It felt literally impossible to believe that Liverpool would exit the transfer window without signing a controlling midfield player.

But they did just that. And with Curtis Jones gone - another attacking midfielder turned centre-midfielder - Liverpool actually lost their best controlling central player. Now they're even lighter through the middle of the pitch.

We're not entirely sure how it's gotten to this point and Liverpool should never have entered this season with the midfield options they have. It's ridiculously poor squad planning that they have.

But it does appear that overwhelming sentiment and pressure will land them a new midfielder in 2027. We hope that's Lamine Camara . Above all, we just hope it's not another attacking player.

articles.title: Sivera para su primer penalti en Primera: "Es un dato un poco ridículo..."
articles.standfirst: El portero babazorro acumulaba 25 penas máximas encajando en la máxima categoría
articles.summary: El portero babazorro acumulaba 25 penas máximas encajando en la máxima categoría
articles.body: El Alavés se abona a los puntos en San Mamés. Los babazorros vencieron la pasada temporada sin rematar a puerta y este sábado lograron un valioso punto sin probar a Unai Simón. Cuatro puntos en sus dos últimas visitas con apenas un disparo entre palos. El protagonismo estuvo en la otra portería, donde la actuación de Antonio Sivera resultó decisiva en el resultado final para dejar por tercera vez en estas siete jornadas su portería a cero. Sivera contribuyó con seis intervenciones, entre ellas una pena máxima de Oihan Sancet que detuvo en la segunda mitad. No era una parada más. De hecho, era el primer lanzamiento desde los once metros que detenía en sus 123 encuentros en Primera. Los 25 penaltis que había afrontado hasta la fecha habían acabado dentro de su portería. En Bilbao puso fin a esta travesía con una parada determinante que vale un punto. El capitán babazorro llevaba casi cuatro años sin adivinar un penalti. Su última alegría desde los once metros tuvo lugar en Tenerife el 7 de diciembre de 2022 con Enric Gallego como oponente. Entonces, el Alavés militaba en Segunda y cinco días antes había detenido otra pena máxima con Uzuni como ejecutor. Desde entonces, el portero de Jávea acumulaba 25 penaltis encajando. Cada pena máxima suponía una losa más profunda. Sivera ya sabe lo que es parar un penalti en Primera y seguro que eso alimentará su confianza la próxima vez que tenga que afrontar un lanzamiento desde los once metros. Su importancia dentro y fuera del campo está fuera de toda duda, es una pieza imprescindible desde la marcha de Pacheco y en San Mamés acabó con una de las pocas asignaturas que tenía pendientes. Después del partido, Sivera habló para DAZN y explicó la acción. "Sinceramente con lo metido que estaba en el partido no estaba pensando ni en el dato. Es verdad que es un dato un poco ridículo pero a veces cuando no te salen las cosas no hay otra que seguir, ponerle la mejor de las intenciones. Hoy he podido romper la racha y sacar lo mejor para el grupo". "Estamos contentos de que nos pasen cosas buenas como es empatar en San Mamés o que Sivera haya vuelto a parar un penalti", apuntó Quique Sánchez Flores.

articles.title: Luke Williams: Peterborough United sack manager after Doncaster defeat
articles.summary: Peterborough United sack manager Luke Williams after Saturday's defeat at home by Doncaster leaves them second from bottom in League One.
articles.body:
Peterborough United have sacked manager Luke Williams after Saturday's defeat at home by Doncaster Rovers left them second from bottom in League One.

The loss was the Posh' third in a winless five-game run in the league, which has them just one point above Wigan Athletic at the foot of the table.

Despite the miserable run in the third tier, Williams managed to guide Peterborough into the fourth round of the Carabao Cup for the first time since 2009 after overseeing a 7-6 penalty shootout win against Barnsley in a game that finished 3-3 just four days earlier.

The former Swansea City and Notts County boss lasted less than 11 months in the job, having replaced Darren Ferguson - who was in his fourth spell with the club - when the Posh were bottom of the table in October 2025.

While Peterborough recovered to finish 18th under the 45-year-old, another slow start this term has cost him his job after just seven league games.

Peterborough United 0-2 Doncaster Rovers

Peterborough said the decision to sack Williams had not been "taken lightly" but added that the board "felt it had no other choice but to make a change".

"The team's form in League One has not matched the board's expectations, particularly given the significant investment made in the squad," the club said in a statement.

Peterborough's summer recruitment drive included bringing Danny Ormerod from AFC Fylde in for a fee of at least £600,000 , while Ethan Williams was said to have cost a "sizeable" sum when he was signed from Manchester United.

Williams, who took time out from football after losing his job at Swansea to work as a customer care assistant at Bristol Airport, won 18 matches and lost 20 in the 47 he took charge of.

His time at Weston Homes Stadium has been the shortest of his managerial career which started with a spell at Swindon Town that came to an end in May 2017.

He went on to work as an assistant manager to Russell Martin at MK Dons and Swansea before he got another shot at being the boss with Notts County - a club he guided to promotion from the National League in 2023 before moving on to take the helm of Swansea in the Championship in January 2024.

Williams' replacement has not been immediately lined up at Peterborough, who have put the existing coach team of assistant manager Ryan Harley and coach Connell Rawlinson in temporary charge.

articles.title: Arsenal boss Mikel Arteta accuses players of failing to 'respect the game' as champions suffer first defeat of season to Brighton
articles.summary: Arsenal's winning start to the season came to an end as Brighton emerged 3-0 winners at the Amex Stadium; Mikel Arteta was disappointed by his side's performance on both a physical and technical level; Man City now have chance to go three points clear in the Premier League
articles.body:
Goals from Pascal Gross, Charalampos Kostoulas and Chema Andres consigned the champions to their heaviest Premier League loss in three years and abruptly ended their winning start to the campaign.

Arteta felt his players were found wanting in the physical battle on the south coast and also bemoaned their sloppiness on the ball as they were overwhelmed by Brighton's pressing.

"A very disappointing result and performance," he said. "Full credit to Brighton in the manner they performed and went about the game.

Latest news and rumours: Brighton | Arsenal

"They were another gear from us in the basics of the game. They were always first in the first duel, in the second actions, second balls, and they started to play from there.

"And on top of that, when we had the ball, especially in our own half, we were extremely poor technically, not respecting the game and the game principles you have to apply against a team that want to press you man to man.

"That never gives you the option to dominate and control the game in the manner you want. And then when we had big chances, we didn't put them away.

"We have to make sure we learn the lesson because this can't happen again."

Speaking in his press conference, Arteta added: "There are a lot of moments when the ball is 50-50 and it changes hands, and most of the time it was for them.

"Sometimes there were some technical errors involved that opened us up in a really difficult way, but that's something to learn.

"From the first throw-in you could sense it, it was so clear. We put ourselves in trouble one time, two times, three times and we needed to get out of that much quicker than that. That's one of the biggest lessons that we have to take from the game."

The defeat ends a run of eight consecutive Premier League wins for Arsenal. Arteta, although critical of his side's display, called for perspective ahead of the three-week international break.

"It's not going to take away what the team has done and the boys have done in the last six or seven weeks since coming back from the World Cup," he said.

"With 18 players coming back, what we've done, the way we've competed and the amount of games we've won has been remarkable.

"But this is a big lesson for all of us to understand what it takes to win at this level."

It is not often that Arsenal are outfought but they could not live with Brighton's intensity and the numbers backed up Arteta's criticism.

Brighton's pressing was incredible in the first half and the Gunners couldn't match their level in the second period either.

According to Opta, the hosts won possession in the final third nine times. It is the second-highest total by any side in a Premier League game this season. It is also the most by any side against Arsenal in any game either this term or last.

Arsenal were left disorientated by the blizzard of early Brighton pressure, with summer signing Bruno Guimaraes finding it particularly difficult, and could not recover their poise.

Having smothered Arsenal with their pressing, Brighton asserted their dominance from set-pieces too, scoring their third goal from one of several dangerous corners and, ultimately, claiming revenge for their acrimonious defeat in this fixture last season.

Hurzeler: We were horrible to play against

Fabian Hurzeler savoured a "special" performance from his side as Brighton moved up to third, only two points behind Arsenal.

Their total of 16 goals is the highest by any Premier League side in the first five games of a season since Manchester City hit 19 at the beginning of the 2022/23 campaign.

"Beating the current champions and the best team in England is something special," he said.

"But it's not because the result is special, it's the performance. The boys showed real togetherness and intensity.

"They were horrible to play against and that's because we did the basic things right. Overall I was very pleased with the performance.

"I think we deserved to win. It's a moment the players and the staff can enjoy because they worked hard for this but it's also important why we had this success, because we did the basics right and we were brilliant in the duels."

articles.standfirst: Peligro de crisis para azulones y blanquiazules
articles.summary: Peligro de crisis para azulones y blanquiazules
articles.body:
Sólo es septiembre y sólo es la séptima jornada, pero un mal resultado en el Coliseum (14.00, DAZN) llevaría a vivir un parón que se haría muy largo para Getafe o Málaga. Los de Bordalás han ganado un solo partido, mientras que los de Funes, que están comprobando cómo se las gasta la máxima categoría, todavía no lo han hecho. Urge sumar.

Cómo llega el Getafe . El Getafe busca vencer después de cuatro jornadas sin hacerlo. Son tres puntos vitales, tanto en la tabla como en lo moral, con más de dos semanas de parón por selecciones. Marcharse con una victoria es vital para un equipo, el azulón, al que le está costando arrancar en estas primeras fechas de campeonato. Bordalás recupera a Terrats, clave en el equipo hasta el momento y, junto a su hinchada, querrán recuperar la senda de la victoria.

Cómo llega el Málaga . El Málaga no tiene mucho tiempo para lamerse las heridas tras la dura derrota del pasado jueves ante el Villarreal en La Rosaleda. Los blanquiazules están tocados en lo anímico y también en una enfermería que no ha dejado de crecer. Aznou y Cajuste no llegarán al partido. Dos bajas más que no ayudan a cambiar mucho los planes del equipo en dos días. Funes y el vestuario han pedido tranquilidad a pesar de los discretos resultados.

El duelo del partido . Soria vs Herrero . Se suele decir que si los porteros son los mejores de sus equipos no es buena noticia, pero eso no es culpa de los metas de Getafe y Málaga, que están haciendo su trabajo a la perfección. El azulón sigue sumando.

articles.title: Lautaro homenajea a Mazzola para neutralizar a la Roma
articles.standfirst: El argentino respondió al doblete de Manu Koné y rescató un empate (2-2) para el Inter que pone fin al pleno de ambos equipos
articles.summary: El argentino respondió al doblete de Manu Koné y rescató un empate (2-2) para el Inter que pone fin al pleno de ambos equipos
articles.body: Era el duelo más esperado del 'Calcio' en este inicio de temporada antes de afrontar el primer parón de selecciones. Roma e Inter llegaban con pleno de victorias. Pero, tras el doblete de Manu Koné en la primera parte, Lautaro hizo lo propio para neutralizarlo tras el paso por vestuarios (2-2) como homenaje a Sandro Mazzola. Molina, que venía de completar su primer gran partido con la Roma, repitió en el carril izquierdo... así como Balerdi en el eje de la zaga junto a Mancini y Hermoso. En el Inter, fue Zielinski quien ocupó el puesto de 'regista' del lesionado Calhanoglu. Chivu, eso sí, recuperaba a Bisseck, Dimarco, Curtis Jones y Lautaro. El minuto de silencio en el Olímpico en memoria de Mazzola fue respetadísimo. Ahora bien, la Roma saltó al campo a jugarle de tú a tú para demostrar por qué son la gran alternativa al título... y Manu Koné tardó cinco minutos en abrir el marcador. Molina, que había recuperado el balón, descargó un centro del Dybala para que el galo volease sin oposición. Llegó a tocar Josep Martínez, pero poco pudo hacer. La personalidad con la que estaba jugando la Roma era la propia de un equipo que está construyendo cuerpo de campeón. Las persecuciones individuales ahogaron a un Inter incapaz de desplegarse e, incluso, alternó fases con balón donde los de Chivu no paraban de perseguir sombras. El único despiste en toda la primera parte derivó en un mano a mano de Bisseck desbaratado por Svilar originado de un saque de banda. Fueron, sin duda, los mejores minutos de un Inter que tuvo el 1-1 en botas de Lautaro a centro de Dimarco. No tambaleó la Roma y, aunque fue anulado en primera instancia, Koné volvió a ampliar la ventaja en el 36'. La defensa del área, otra vez, dejó a deber en el cuadro 'nerazzurro'. Las opciones del Inter pasaban por reconectarse al partido desde que el balón se pusiese en juego... y el arranque de la segunda parte fue inmejorable. No se había cumplido ni el primer minuto cuando Lautaro lanzó en largo Marcus Thuram desde el centro del campo y acompañó la jugada para batir a Svilar rematando con la izquierda al primer toque. El gol le dio gasolina a un Inter que, además, vio entrar a Carlos Augusto y Sucic al terreno de juego. Sucedió todo lo contrario en la Roma. Gasperini detectó que el tanque estaba comenzando a vaciarse y, a la hora de partido, realizó un triple cambio. Se marcharon Mancini, Koné y Molina. Gasperini y Chivu respondían a cada movimiento del otro. El Inter quemó naves con la entrada de Luís Henrique por Bastoni... mientras que Ghilardi cubrió la lesión de un Balerdi que estaba realizando un partido enorme. Entre tanto, Josep Martínez puso la cara para negarle a Malen el 3-1 y Svilar se estiró para detener un disparo lejano de Diouf. Ambos equipos llegaron 'fundidos' al tramo final del choque. Unos para intentar rescatar un punto... y otros para seguir sumando de a tres. Primero Svilar, y después el larguero, salvaron a la Roma. A la siguiente, sin embargo, Lautaro le 'fusiló' para poner el 2-2 a falta de poco más de 10'. Ninguno pudo alargar su pleno de victorias, pero prometen mantener un pulso vibrante por el Scudetto.

articles.title: Al Castellón le llega media hora para seguir siendo líder
articles.standfirst: Manita al Tenerife, con doblete de Camara, en un partido que quedó sentenciado en la primera parte
articles.summary: Manita al Tenerife, con doblete de Camara, en un partido que quedó sentenciado en la primera parte
articles.body: El Castellón ha justificado su condición de líder con una victoria autoritaria frente al Tenerife (5-0) en un partido que resolvió con tres goles en la primera media hora y que rubricó con otros dos en la reanudación. El equipo de la Plana mostró su superioridad desde el inicio y pudo marcar en el minuto 3 en un remate de Camara, solo ante el portero, con parada de Dani Martín. Los albinegros no desaprovecharon su siguiente oportunidad, a los 10 minutos, en una gran jugada asociativa que resolvió Diego Barri, batiendo de tiro raso al meta visitante. A raíz de ese tanto se acentuó el dominio del Castellón, lo que le dio premio en el minuto 24 en una acción rápida con desmarque final del centrocampista de 18 años Maty Orozco, flamante internacional absoluto con Colombia, que no perdonó a Dani Martín. Cinco minutos después, los orelluts sacaron petróleo en un error en la salida de balón del Tenerife para robar por medio de Iñigo Córdoba, cuyo pase de la muerte no desaprovechó Camara para poner el 3-0 con sólo media hora disputada. En el segundo tiempo, el Tenerife salió algo mejor y pudo acortar distancias en un mano a mano de Gomis con Matthys que salvó el portero local (55'). Pero los de la Plana hicieron el cuarto siete minutos después a través de Pablo Santiago, que acababa de ingresar en el terreno de juego y que aprovechó la asistencia de Juanjo Nieto para ampliar aún más la renta. Un cuarto de hora después, Ousmane Camara definió en el mano a mano con Dani Martín para lograr su doblete y convertir el definitivo 5-0. El equipo orellut está muy fuerte. 16/18 puntos. Invicto. Sólo dos tantos en contra. Los que entran desde el banquillo aportan goles y rinden a un gran nivel. Y Pablo Hernández cumple un año en el banquillo de un equipo que cada vez pinta mejor.

articles.title: El Celta recuerda cómo se golea
articles.standfirst: Primera victoria de la temporada ante un Racing que se llevó otro saco y con los titulares
articles.summary: Primera victoria de la temporada ante un Racing que se llevó otro saco y con los titulares
articles.body: El duelo de corneados esta semana, por el Omonia chipriota el Celta y por el Barça el Racing, se lo llevó la escuadra de Giráldez ante la de José Alberto, que esta vez sí sacó al equipo titular, el que descansó en el Nou Camp, y tampoco rascó nada en Vigo. No se llevó 7, pero se llevó otro saquito. Giráldez también cambió medio equipo respecto al de la Europa League, manteniendo a Jutglà de artillero vistas las bajas del equipo, y el partido arrancó a toda pastilla con los dos buscando el ataque sin complejos. Eso sí, en los primeros 20 minutos, con mayor dominio verde, ni un tiro a puerta, ni peligro más allá de algún centro con mala leche de Zabiri o Mantilla, cortado por la zaga. Un tirito de Pablo García en el 26 a las manos de Radu. Pero del Celta, nada de nada. Pases en largo demasiado largos... "Tenemos en la cabeza que no ganamos y eso nos atenaza", decía en la previa el técnico. Hasta que un error en la salida del balón del Racing, recuperado por Jutglà, golpeó en el brazo de Belocian para evitar el recorte en un bote y de la nada, brotó un penalti tras revisión de VAR. Hugo González lo tiró fuerte, ajustando bajo a Agirrezabala, que si mide 5 cms. más la para, y en el primer tiro a puerta, allá por el minuto 32', se puso por delante el Celta. El cuarto gol en Liga del equipo, el primero del canterano en Primera. Un regalo que sirvió para que el equipo se descorchara mental y futbolísticamente. Arrancó ahí otro partido para el Celta, venido arriba después de que en muchos partidos lo buscó más sin encontrarlo, y hoy casi le vino sin querer el gol. Jutglà tuvo el segundo un par de minutos después, pero le sacó el meta vasco el tiro cruzado dentro del área. El Racing no se echó atrás y Vicente tuvo el empate en una falta directa tras una contra estupenda. Se la encontró Radu tras tocar la barrera. Hoy la suerte era celeste. Tanto que en el primer balón que robó el equipo, limpio y poderoso Moriba sacó zancada, sacó un zurdazo colocado y embocó el segundo desde el borde del área tras un quiebro con cambio de pierna: un golazo que daba demasiado premio a los locales al borde del descanso. Lo curioso es que para la segunda parte los cambios los hizo Giráldez, banda derecha nueva con Carreira y Durán. Pero el primer tiro a puerta fue del Racing, que subió a Pablo García como segunda punta. En el primer minuto a ver si con el sol se despistaba Radu probó de lejos Ramón, perro viejo, pero no funcionó. Dominaba el Racing otra vez, peo otra vez casi hace el gol del Celta en el 55' cuando Ramón sacó ya casi bajo palos el tiro de Durán, que superaba al portero y a la defensa con un pase filtrado largo que se habían zampado. Firme atrás, no concedía ni una el equipo de Giráldez. Tocaba mover ficha en el sesentaytantos, un clásico de la Liga, y la movió el técnico visitante con un triple cambio, Canales entre ellos, que tocó la primera de maravilla en apertura, y el centro al 'Búfalo' Villalibre terminó en gol, anulado por fuera de juego. Era la ocasión, porque ahí se apagaron las luces del Racing. En el otro lado volvía Borja Iglesias, que sacó tarjeta a Belocian en el primer duelo, y prolongando de cabeza casi fabrica otro gol al minuto siguiente. A la tercera que merodeó el área, con dejadita atrás estupenda, llegó el rechace a Román que clavó un trallazo violentísimo desde 26 metros y a 120 km/h. Otra vez le faltaron centímetros a Julen y en el 70' estaba todo el pescado vendido con un 3-0 que hacía frotarse los ojos a la gente en la grada. Ya sin el peso encima del mes horribilis previo, se desató arriba el Celta. Román casi mete el gol de la jornada con un remate a la carrera y en el 78' llegó el cuarto de Durán, una jugada de nuevo con Borja, que dio una masterclass en 20 minutos, con apertura y pase, centro de Hugo Álvarez y a la carrera mataba Durán. Más goles en un partido que en toda la temporada. Cosas del fútbol. El quinto lo salvó Agirrezabala con un manoplazo a Núñez que se colaba abajo, y luego Belocian cortando un pase de la muerta del lateral que era de oro para Durán, y más luego aún de tacón Hugo Burcio que intuyó el dolido meta visitante. El del honor lo tuvo Guliashvili en semivolea, pero ni por esas, a 3 metros de la puerta y casi solito, pero no era el día verde, era el azul. Al final lo remató Durán en otro pase estupendo de Hugo Álvarez, cruzando sobre la marcha a media altura para el quinto. Manotazo con el que el Celta se descorcha definitivamente.

articles.title: Jobe Bellingham sirve el pleno de un Dortmund que se marcha líder al parón
articles.standfirst: El hermano de Jude asistió a Beier en el triunfo frente al Stuttgart
articles.summary: El hermano de Jude asistió a Beier en el triunfo frente al Stuttgart
articles.body: No hay mayor referente para Jobe que su hermano Jude, que ha arrancado la temporada con el Real Madrid prolongando su estelar Mundial con Inglaterra. Dispuesto a seguir sus pasos, el menor de los Bellingham asistió a Beier en el triunfo frente al Stuttgart (2-2) de un Borussia Dortmund que se marchará al parón líder con pleno de victorias en Bundesliga. Jude, que venía de completar el anterior partido contra el Paderborn, arrancó desde el banquillo. Fueron Veerman y Nmecha, que venía de marcar un doblete, los que llevaron la 'manija' en un Dortmund donde Fábio Silva, convocado con Portugal, también esperó su oportunidad en el banquillo. La mejor noticia, sin duda, fue la vuelta a Karetsas a la convocatoria. La alternancia en las ocasiones por parte de Stuttgart y Dortmund fue constante durante toda la primera parte. Beier y Schlotterbeck empezaron avisando... y, pasada la primera media hora, Undav y El Khannouss contestaron. La ocasión más clara, eso sí, la tuvo un Félix Nmecha a quien le bloquearon un disparo franco desde el interior del área. Nwaneri, antes de dejar su sitio a Karetsas pasado el 60', recogió un balón suelto en área para batir a Bredlow... en posición adelantada. Junto al griego también salto al campo un Jobe Bellingham que, menos de 10' después, asistió a Max Beier con un envío tenso desde el costado derecho. Estuvo listo el alemán para atacar el área pequeña desde el segundo palo. Lo pudo cerrar Karetsas con un disparo que se marchó rozando la cepa del poste. Trató de apretar el Stuttgart en busca del empate. Pero, más allá de un 'cabezazo' tierno de Sauer que murió en las manos de Kobel, tampoco incomodó a un Borussia Dortmund que no arrancaba con un 12/12 desde la 15-16 con Thomas Tuchel.

articles.title: Sayin, Jeremiah Smith Impress, Final Box Score Stats, Highlights, Draft Stock from Ohio State's Win
articles.summary: Julian Sayin, Jeremiah Smith and the Ohio State Buckeyes had no problem putting up points in their 59-3 win over the Kent State Golden Flashes.
articles.body:
Julian Sayin, Jeremiah Smith and the Ohio State Buckeyes had no problem putting up points in their 59-3 win over the Kent State Golden Flashes.

Sayin threw for a pair of touchdowns, while Smith averaged 17 yards per catch in a contest that was finished by halftime.

The Buckeyes did whatever they wanted in the first half on offense. One of the results of that was Smith breaking the Buckeyes' all-time receiving yards record.

Smith caught five passes for 85 yards, but he did not find the end zone, like he did in the first two weeks of the regular season. He's up to 400 receiving yards on the season through three games.

Sayin spread the ball around to seven different receivers during his time on the field. He was taken out of the game in the third quarter with the Buckeyes up by 42.

Sayin produced a pair of touchdown passes to Brandon Inniss and Nate Roberts.

The touchdown pass to Inniss came on the final play of the first half.

Ohio State's other four touchdowns with Sayin on the field came through the rushing attack. Bo Jackson, Ja'Kobi Jackson and Isaiah West combined for the four rushing scores.

The competitiveness will ramp up next week for the Buckeyes, as they begin Big Ten play against Illinois.

Sayin and Smith will be relied a ton to navigate a conference workload that includes Indiana, USC, Oregon and Michigan

articles.title: El Celta gana 119 días después y lo hace goleando
articles.standfirst: El triunfo da tranquilidad a los de Claudio Giráldez para el parón
articles.summary: El triunfo da tranquilidad a los de Claudio Giráldez para el parón
articles.body: Desde el pasado 23 de mayo, el Celta no ganaba. Habían pasado desde entonces 119 días, casi cuatro meses, aunque es cierto que con vacaciones de por medio. Lo hizo goleando en Balaídos, estadio del que se habían escapado ocho de nueve puntos en juego esta temporada. Una victoria que da tranquilidad a los de Claudio Giráldez de cara al parón. El último triunfo céltico había tenido lugar en el encuentro que cerró la pasada temporada. Fue en Balaídos ante el Sevilla y con gol de Moriba, el mediocampista repitió diana este sábado. También marcó Hugo González de penalti, el primer gol en LaLiga para el valenciano, estrella del Celta Fortuna la pasada temporada. Era su quinto encuentro esta temporada en los que también dio dos asistencias. Miguel Román y Pablo Durán, por partida doble, completaron la goleada. El Celta hizo más goles al Racing de Santander que en los siete encuentros anteriores, entre Liga y Europa League, en los que había marcado únicamente tres tantos. Los serios problemas en ataque de principio de temporada desaparecieron ante el Racing de Santander. La rotación múltiple de Claudio Giráldez le llevó, en esta ocasión, a realizar siete permutas con respecto al partido de Chipre. Únicamente repitieron, en el once, Radu, Álvaro Núñez, Miguel Román y Jutglà.

articles.title: Livakovic se estrena con el Barça
articles.standfirst: Flick apuesta por el portero croata ante la baja de Joan García
articles.summary: Flick apuesta por el portero croata ante la baja de Joan García
articles.body: Livakovic se estrenó este sábado por la noche como culé en el Sánchez-Pizjuán. Aunque Hansi Flick apostó por Szczęsny cuando Joan García se lesionó el miércoles contra el Racing de Santander, en Sevilla el elegido fue el croata. Joan García arrastraba unas leves molestias en la rodilla derecha, tras un resbalón el pasado miércoles, y Hansi Flick prefirió que no viajase a Sevilla por precaución. Todo apuntaba a que sería Szczesny el que estaría bajo palos en el Pizjuán, pero el técnico sorprendió dando la titularidad a Livakovic. "Lo hemos analizado todo y pensábamos que había que cambiar en la portería y lo hemos hecho", dijo Flick. Ahora, los tres metas azulgranas ya han debutado esta campaña. El cancerbero croata firmó a finales de agosto procedente del Fenerbahce, en una operación que se cerró en dos millones de euros fijos más medio millón en variables. El arquero fichó hasta junio de 2030. A su llegada, la intención de la institución era que Livakovic fuese el segundo portero de Hansi Flick, algo que parece confirmarse esta noche en Sevilla.

articles.title: Arsenal defeat at Brighton is a big lesson - Mikel Arteta
articles.summary: An uncharacteristic performance from Arsenal saw the Gunners ship three goals in the defeat to Brighton - but could the loss be the "big lesson" they needed?
articles.body:
An uncharacteristic performance from Arsenal saw them ship three goals at Brighton - but boss Mikel Arteta believes their first Premier League defeat this season could prove a "big lesson".

The defending champions have been tipped by many to retain the title they won last season for the first time in 22 years.

An impressive seven-match winning start to this campaign in all competitions - nine in successive league games dating back to April - backed up that belief.

But Arsenal were humbled on the south coast as a well-drilled and clinical Brighton outfit beat them comfortably 3-0 to go third in the table.

Arteta, whose side did not lose by more than a single goal in the top flight last term, acknowledged the Seagulls "deserved" the success and there were lessons the Gunners needed to take heading into the international break.

The manner of the defeat - Arsenal 's heaviest in a season where they were the reigning top-flight champions since 1989 - will also offer hope to their title rivals that they are not invincible.

Arsenal handed first loss by brilliant Brighton

Since taking charge in 2019, Arteta has made a point of reiterating how much he values physicality and the demands he puts on his side to win duels.

But against Brighton , Arsenal were dominated all over the pitch and lost challenges which they would usually be expected to win.

Arteta said he was "extremely disappointed" as his side were "very far" from doing the basics he expected, with uncertainty in defence, a loss of midfield control and lack of attacking creativity.

Asked why they were below par, the Spaniard added: "Well, the first one because Brighton they were really good, and they had another bite, and at the times it was better.

"There are a lot of moments when the ball is 50-50 and it changes hands and most of the time it was for them.

"Sometimes there were some technical errors very much involved that opened us up in a really difficult way, but that's something to learn."

He was quick to remind the media in his news conference after the game that it was still a good start to the season.

The Gunners had 15 players at the World Cup which meant that a large part of the squad joined up for pre-season later than the rest of their team-mates.

"That's not going to take away what the team has done and the boys have done in the last six or seven weeks since coming back from the World Cup," added Arteta.

"What we've done and the way we've competed and the amount of games we've won has been remarkable, but this is a big lesson for all of us to understand what it takes to win at this level."

Brighton are currently the Premier League's top scorers with 16 goals - hitting eight of them in the past week - and could have had more against an Arsenal side who pride themselves on keeping clean sheets.

The Gunners conceded the fewest goals of any side last season and just one got past David Raya in their first four league games before Saturday's defeat.

"It should have been more, the chances Brighton created, they were that good," said former Newcastle striker Alan Shearer on BBC Radio 5 Live.

"They absolutely battered Arsenal . How many times have we said that recently? From start to finish today Brighton were magnificent, every single one of them played their part.

"They were strong, they were fit, they went after Arsenal . They had no fear and it worked brilliantly for them, it should have been six or seven goals."

The Gunners were 2-0 down at the break and have not recovered to win from such a position in a league game since March 2008 at Bolton.

"Every time Brighton chased down the ball, they got it absolutely spot on. They did it as a team, they didn't do it individually," added Shearer.

"They thought, 'we respect Arsenal but we're not going to give them any space to play'.

"The organisation was great and that just doesn't happen on it's own and you've got to give [manager] Fabian Hurzeler credit for that."

Arsenal spent around £200m in the summer transfer window in a bid to strengthen the squad to challenge for more honours, and Arteta was asked if they needed reminding how tough the Premier League can be.

He said: "I think they knew, I think we knew how tough it was going to be today, and the first thing that we had discussed was about the first part.

"If you don't get out of that first part as winners, it will be extremely difficult to dominate the game and to have any probability of winning the game.

"We knew that, but that's again credit to them for what they've done because they've overcome us and they had another edge than we did.

"And that's something that at this level it's extremely important to respect and to understand before anything else."

Former Premier League defender Curtis Davies believed the Gunners could put the result and display down to a "blip".

"Their form this season has so far been good, this has been a really shocking performance," he said on 5 Live.

"That defence today was nowhere near what it's used to being. The disappointment will be a set-piece goal conceded, Arsenal will have a real long look at themselves.

"They didn't lay a glove on Brighton , and didn't make anything of their attacking situations."

articles.title: Matías Orozco, la joya del mediocampo de la Selección Colombia que brilla en España
articles.standfirst: El golazo de Matías Orozco en España para celebrar su convocatoria a la Selección Colombia
articles.summary: El golazo de Matías Orozco en España para celebrar su convocatoria a la Selección Colombia
articles.body: La confianza entregada por el cuerpo técnico de la Selección Colombia ha encontrado una respuesta inmediata en el terreno de juego. Apenas unos días después de confirmarse su sorpresiva y esperada inclusión en la lista de convocados por Néstor Lorenzo para los próximos compromisos amistosos de la 'Tricolor', el centrocampista colombiano Matías Orozco vivió una jornada consagratoria en el fútbol español. Durante el duelo válido por la sexta fecha de la segunda división de España (LaLiga 2), Orozco anotó su primer gol con la camiseta del Castellón en la victoria parcial frente al CD Tenerife. Corría el minuto 23 del compromiso cuando el mediocampista de 18 años arrancó con decisión desde la zona medular. Tras conducir el balón, armó una precisa pared con su compañero Jakobsen, se incrustó en el área rival y definió con frialdad ante la salida del guardameta, sellando el 2-0 parcial para los albinegros. Más allá de la anotación, el desempeño del canterano del Deportivo Cali en el primer tiempo dejó cifras sobresalientes: 91 % de precisión en pases completados, 100 % de efectividad en envíos largos y una calificación promedio de 7.5, consolidándose como eje fundamental del centro del campo de su equipo. El momento de Orozco no es una casualidad individual, sino parte del notable arranque de temporada del Castellón, líder invicto de LaLiga 2 tras sumar 16 puntos de 18 posibles y consolidarse como serio aspirante al ascenso a la primera división. El volante, cuya ficha pertenece al Brighton & Hove Albion de la Premier League y se encuentra cedido a préstamo en España, ha dejado ver su ambición en declaraciones recientes, donde señaló identificarse con el estilo de juego de referentes internacionales como Jude Bellingham y Enzo Fernández. Asimismo, técnicos como Rafael Dudamel, quien lo dirigió en su etapa con el Deportivo Cali, ya vaticinaban el impacto del juvenil al calificar sus condiciones como excepcionales dentro de la camada de recambio del fútbol colombiano. Con esta anotación, Orozco no solo estrena su casilla goleadora en el balompié europeo, sino que ratifica los argumentos futbolísticos por los que Néstor Lorenzo lo sumó al proceso de renovación de la Selección Colombia absoluta.
